notes.title: v1.2 is Live!!!
notes.content:
[h1]Version 1.2 Update[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37601880/938b432780dd43b4bc611bcd421b32e8e34cb274.png[/img]


[b]System[/b]
[list]
[*] An "Exit Island" Feature has been added to the pause menu. Use this function to teleport back to the entrance on the overworld you used to enter the island. Does not work at the start of the game before exiting the Ancient Island. If used after entering an island with the phoenix, the player is returned to that landing room.
[*] Gamepad glyphs added for Steam controller support.
[*] Bulgarian and Romanian language support added.
[*] All islands except for Serpent Stacks now have maps.
[*] The in game timer is now precise and tracks / displays seconds on the end game screen.
[*] The game now properly saves and restores window position from the previous session.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Frozen Spire Albatrosses have been reworked.
[list]
[*] A question mark appears above birds of paths that have not been traversed yet.
[*] The map shows indicators of traversed and not yet traversed paths.
[*] Taking an albatross flight for the first time takes the player to the end of the flight path as it did previously, but now both albatrosses are unlocked.
[*] When the player uses an albatross that has been unlocked, they can now choose to fly to any other unlocked albatross on the map.
[/list]
[/list]
[i]Developer note: The previous system was confusing and frustrating for most players. The goal was a sense of discovery and mapping out the paths of the island as a sort of meta puzzle. I think the new system achieves those goals without the frustration. Previously, using each new albatross could feel like a more and more confusing web of paths with no rhyme or reason. The new system however makes unlocking each albatross a reward and makes getting around the island EASIER instead of more confusing.[/i]

[list]
[*] Some puzzles and parts of puzzles that were trivialized by the Kite Cloak have been reworked.
[/list]
[i]Developer note: Although the goal with items is to absolutely make some parts of puzzles easier or solvable in different ways, there were some cases where puzzles were made too easy with the Kite Cloak.[/i]
 
[list]
[*] Puzzle Availability and Reworks: The following puzzles have been made more clear that they are inaccessible, and / or have been generally reworked.
[list]
[*] Stoney Cliffs B4 Gopher Glove requirement made more clear.
[*] Tidal Reef D2, new gem puzzle.
[*] Raging Volcano D0 Salamander Shirt required to approach the puzzle.
[*] Spire B3 reworked.
[*] Spire D3 reworked to make more interesting and also avoid confusion about accessibility.
[*] Spire B2 top right star puzzle slightly reworked.
[*] E4 Tweaked slightly to communicate the cloak requirement for the key.
[/list]
[*]Removed some confusing hints at future content.
[list]
[*] Dead end overworld paths removed.
[*] Mysterious pedestals on Serpent Stacks removed.
[*] Rooms that are basically inaccessible / contain future content are now blacked out on the map.
[*] Eastern Shoal: Temporarily removed the pattern puzzle and added a new reward to this island.
[/list]
[/list]
[i]Developer note: This puzzle is one of my personal favorites and will most definitely be making a return, however I feel it doesn’t currently fit with the style of gameplay and puzzles for the basic stars required for 100% completion. It will return in a future update with a non-star reward.[/i]

[b]Art[/b]
[list]
[*] An indicator of which big bells have been rung has been added to the large stone that blocks the Beast Ridge for clarity.
[*] Added effects to the Frozen Spire egg incubators when the correct egg is in the player’s possession.
[*] Doubled the speed of the water elemental copy animation when copying an air elemental.
[*] Rune Stone artwork and item available effect updated.
[/list]
[i]Developer note: The goal is to make it clear that the Rune Stones in the god rooms are immediately available to the player without any items or upgrades, and that they are an important key item required for progression.[/i]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed several bugs and inconsistencies between elementals and various elements such as rivers and shadow twins.
[*] Fixed various soft and hard lock issues.
[*] The 30 star stone in Tidal Reef A2 no longer shows a cost of 1 after the tide is lowered.
[*] Moved one of the possible positions of the idol statues on the Raging Volcano which could be come obfuscated by the streamer mode window.
[*] Some fixes to missing secret indicators.
[*] Minor localization fixes.
[*] Various map fixes.
[*] Various visual, tile, and collision fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Testing v1.2!
notes.content:
[h1]v1.2 Beta Test[/h1]
[h2]v1.0 -> v1.2?[/h2]
v1.1 Ended up becoming much larger than originally expected. This update is large enough that it warrants skipping ahead in my versioning system.

[h2]Feature Preview[/h2]
The full patch notes are available on Discord, and will be posted here on Steam when it is ready for release. In the meantime, here’s a preview of some of the major changes:

[list]
[*] An “Exit Island” feature has been added. You can now quickly exit an island onto the overworld from where you entered using the pause menu.
[*] Frozen Spire Albatrosses have had a major rework.
[*] Quality of life improvements such as clarity of puzzle accessibility (Whether or not a puzzle is solvable at the moment).
[*] All islands now have a map excluding the Serpent Stacks.
[*] Romanian language has been added.
[/list]

[h1]STEAM DECK VERIFIED!!![/h1]
For some reason, this has been one of the most exciting moments for me along this game dev journey. It's not necessarily that huge, but I am ecstatic to announce that Isles of Sea and Sky has been officially approved for the Steam Deck!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37601880/2043388a82a0ec9783553a7ae2179fe28104e5e0.png[/img]

- Jason

notes.title: What's Next? - Upcoming Features and Changes
notes.content:
Currently I'm working on a few important features and changes for the game's first major update. I think this update will greatly improve quality of life as well as making the late game a much more fun and smooth experience.

Here's a preview of two things in the works:

[b]Exit Island Feature[/b]
You will be able to exit any island from where you entered, using the pause menu. No more hassle of backtracking / navigating through areas of an island that you do not want to revisit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37601880/5dcbaab93e9821978d322915171bbf414c57ab5d.png[/img]


[b]Albatross Rework[/b]
In addition to some other tweaks to the Frozen Spire in an attempt to smooth out its rough edges and bring it more inline with the rest of the game, the albatross network will be reworked as most people rightfully find it extremely frustrating. Currently exploring and navigating the map is tedious and unrewarding. The new version will reward players for exploring, and make travel easier as they discover more of the map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37601880/5def66128731a10648599129c825f9a640f7a97a.png[/img]

- Jason

[*]Fixed a crash that could occur if an air elemental controlled by the player left the screen.
[*]Added stairs and an arrow block to Tropic B0 for players that solve the puzzle in A0 without the obsidian rune, so that the puzzle does not need to be solved again when they return.

notes.title: v5.2 Demo Update
notes.content:
[h1]Isles of Sea and Sky - Windows v5.2 Demo[/h1]
Due to large changes that impact save files, this version will require new saves. If you would like to continue with a save file for v5.1 of the demo, v5.1 will be temporarily available on the beta branch (See below for more details about how to access it).

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed the ability to water clip to get the star on the Eastern Shoal.
[*] The Shadow Twin should now properly push against objects when the player moves.
[*] Several collision issues with special sprites have been fixed.
[*] Most if not all item % issues should be fixed.
[*] Dirt piles should properly interact with switches after using undo and reset.
[*] An issue with the correct dirt pile color loading on Rolling Rock  has been resolved.
[*] Fixed an issue where certain tiles would sometimes load incorrectly.
[*] Some item pathing issues were fixed.
[*] Other small fixes.
[/list]
[b]System[/b]
[list]
[*] Features that are resolved (e.g. music puzzle, sokoblock puzzle, etc.) are now removed from the room contents display on the right side of the game map.
[*] Start button on gamepad now properly quits out of options menu when in game.
[*] L button and select buttons on gamepad added to more parts of the game as confirm / cancel respectively, to ensure game can be played using only the left side of the controller. This is meant to help with accessibility for some players, and maximizing ability to chill with drink in hand for others.
[*] Back end improvements.
[/list]
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Big Keys have been replaced with Rune Stones: We have seen a large number of players confused by how big keys worked vs. small keys. The game establishes immediately that keys are temporary, and then has to do a lot of heavy lifting that wasn't always effective to change that perception about big keys which are permanent.
[*] Sokoblock puzzle revamped.
[*] [list]
[*] The puzzle has been reworked to avoid self sabotage when the player is still trying to experiment and figure out the puzzle, as well as frustrating backtracking when the player has figured it out. Both of these run extremely counter to two of my core design philosophies: 1. When approaching something new, the player should be able to experiment and learn in a non-punishing environment. 2. Once a player knows how to solve something, it should be reasonably easy to achieve their goal. There should not be frustrating and tedious steps after a solution has been realized. The puzzle also does not require the reset button any longer. This is another benefit as I don’t really want to have to introduce one time mechanics like that.
[*] Not more than one block can start in a perfect position now. I.e. the gold block in a room
[/list] needs only to be pushed forward into the closest spot.
[*] The pattern puzzle has been tweaked to hopefully make the connection between the two parts of the puzzle more obvious.
[*] Rolling Rock: Layout tweaks and updated tileset to match the theme of some other small islands in the full game.
[*] Another star and ancient key have been added to the demo.
[*] Dirt piles now properly fall into pits when digging into them from a covered pit.
[*] Stoney Caverns C1: Upward arrow block replaced with a dirt pile.
[*] Crystal Cavern panning speed increased.
[*] Star Lock in Stoney Caverns C1 increased cost to 23 stars.
[*] The first music note on Stoney Cliffs has been made slightly easier to discover by accident.
[/list]
[b]Art[/b]
[list]
[*] Sokoblock symbols added to the gold door so that the positions can be seen even if all symbols are covered.
[*] Inert arrow blocks have a new design in order to further differentiate themselves from activatable arrow blocks and help with colorblind accessibility.
[*] Added some juice to the digging animations, as well as making them more clear while digging.
[*] Added artwork to the main character sprite after gopher gloves are obtained.
[*] Revamped the god gem UI with new effects.
[*] Items in player’s collection on file screen are now simply drawn from left to right.
[*] Runestones have been added to save file UI.
[*] Added an art effect for “hiding stars,” e.g. the music puzzle now glows to indicate a hiding star.
[*] Other visual tweaks and polish.
[/list]
[b]Sound[/b]
[list]
[*] Stoney Caverns ambiance has been separated into the ambiance channel. The volume of Stoney Caverns music and ambiance can now properly be controlled independently.
[/list]

[h3]Accessing v5.1[/h3]
If you would like to finish up an in progress game on the old version:
[url=https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/store/application/branches]How to access the beta branch.[/url]
Password: WowwieZowwie

notes.title: Akurra v4.0 Demo Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37601880/7e63cad4f0735f3212b1928a4d7c045cf045037c.png[/img]
[h2]v4.0a Notes[/h2]
[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issues with windowed mode and resizing windows.
[*] Various bug fixes.
[/list]

[b]System[/b]
[list]
[*] Options screen with volume control and some window settings added to file select and pause menus.
[*] The ability to add flags to the map has been added.
[*] Windowed mode is now constrained to pixel perfect, 16:9 aspect ratios, with a minimum size of the game's native resolution 384 x 216.
[*] Hotkey added to ending screen that opens the Akurra Steam page.
[*] Item pathing system has been reworked. This should fix several small issues.
[*] Other backend improvements.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Holding push now allows the player to push blocks much faster.
[*] After dying, the room almost immediately goes back to the previous state instead of a full reset.
[*] Undo now happens on key press instead of key release to match other inputs, and can be done much more quickly. After pressing undo, the key can be held to rapidly step through multiple undo states after a short delay.
[*] Stone god screen: Right side green key puzzle tweaked to make the two solutions work better for their intended purposes. Casual players will have an easier time setting up the intended default solution that requires pushing the right most wood block down to be broken, while the alternative solution still allows skipping pushing the wood block down, making it a fast / easy solution but harder for new / casual players to see. It also teaches that stonies can push stone blocks.
[*] Added stone block introductions to Stone D2 and C2.
[*] Stone D1 updated.
[*] The lithophone music puzzle now provides 3 stars.
[*] All music notes are now required to complete the puzzle. Music notes count towards the item collection %.
[*] Updated big bell to only require two boss keys.
[*] Speedrunning tech overhaul.
[/list]

[b]Art[/b]
[list]
[*] Background added to file select screen.
[*] Screen transitions when loading and quitting the game added.
[*] 9 Dot puzzle clue revamped.
[*] Tileset updates, animated tiles added.
[*] Various Art updates.
[/list]

*Note: Unfortunately due to an issue with GameMaker, this update is not immediately available for Linux. Apparently the issue is fixed internally by YoYo Games, and will be available with their next update of GameMaker.

notes.title: Demo Update v3.0
notes.content:
[h1]Update Notes[/h1]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed the player to undo onto a floor obstacle such as a covered pit and move off of it without breaking it.
[*] Fixed a bug where the music puzzle could have more than 3 identical consecutive notes in a sequence.
[*] Fixed a bug where Stoney Boys could activate passive (non-activatable) arrow blocks.
[*] Fixed a bug where two blocks could end up stacked on top of each other rather than one breaking.
[*] Fixed several issues with Stonies rolling off of cliffs.
[*] The player can now move off of a solid tile if they somehow spawn onto one, but can not move from a solid onto a solid.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could undo onto the overworld from an island.
[*] Fixed a bug where the evil twin could push blocks while falling in a pit or dying on spikes.
[*] Fixed an issue with the evil twin’s animations not updating properly.
[*] Fixed some audio issues with the music and increased the bitrate of all in game music tracks.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could spawn misaligned on the overworld from a loaded file.
[*] Other minor and visual bug fixes.
[/list]
[b]System[/b]
[list]
[*] Revamped save system.
[*] Revamped map file system.
[*] Revamped cinematics system.
[*] Revamped map based sound effects system.
[*] The top UI now has its own controller.
[*] Other streamlining of, and new tools and functions for the backend.
[*] Removed sound turning off on minimization. Will add later as an option.
[*] Items and objects (locks, arrow blocks, star locks, etc.) are no longer a part of the undo queue.
[*] The game will no longer reset if the player is idle on the name entry screen.
[*] Version control updates:
[list]
[*] Format of game version string and save file names updated.
[*] The game is now only concerned with major version changes, demo versions, and alpha or beta versions. I.e. New save files will only be required for such major changes, but will not be required when updated from 3.0 to 3.1 for example.
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Some objects have been removed from the demo in order to avoid confusion about what content is available in the current version such as the mysterious pillar that was on Ancient C1.
[*] Removed puzzle blocks (Bronze block that required one or two bronze puzzle pieces). Their function was not clear enough and they did not provide any interesting gameplay. They need some design work and may be reimplemented in a new way in the future.
[*] Some areas, paths, and puzzles have been reworked.
[*] Secret Tunnels: Shadows will now clear in a short line in front of the player. The tiles have been redesigned to provide a slight hint about where branching paths are.
[*] Completion percentage has been added to the pause menu after the player finishes the demo with at least 5 stars.
[*] A completion icon will appear on any island that has no items remaining.
[*] New Undo Feature
[*] Undo is now essentially unlimited on each screen.
[*] Undo works with resets, death, and leaving the room.
[*] Undo states stay in a room where changes are made as long as the player does not make changes in another room, moves more than 2 screens away, or enters another island.
[*] Z has been added as a hotkey for undo.
[*] The player can now skip the end screen cutscene.
[/list]
[b]Visual.[/b]
[list]
[*] New menu pointer design.
[*] Some tilesets have been reworked to reduce visual noise.
[*] Gems have been redesigned.
[*] Other minor visual improvements.
[/list]
[b]Sound[/b]
[list]
[*] The music no longer pauses during reset.
[/list]

Removed sound turning off on minimization. Will add later as an option.
Items and objects (locks, arrow blocks, star locks, etc.) are no longer a part of the undo queue.
The game will no longer reset if the player is idle on the name entry screen.
Format of game version string and save file names updated.

The game is now only concerned with major version changes, demo versions, and alpha or beta versions. I.e. New save files will only be required for such major changes, but will not be required when updated from 3.0 to 3.1 for example.
Some objects have been removed from the demo in order to avoid confusion about what content is available in the current version such as the mysterious pillar that was on Ancient C1.

Removed puzzle blocks (Bronze block that required one or two bronze puzzle pieces). Their function was not clear enough and they did not provide any interesting gameplay. They need some design work and may be reimplemented in a new way in the future.
Some areas, paths, and puzzles have been reworked.
Secret Tunnels: Shadows will now clear in a short line in front of the player. The tiles have been redesigned to provide a slight hint about where branching paths are.
Completion percentage has been added to the pause menu after the player finishes the demo with at least 5 stars.
A completion icon will appear on any island that has no items remaining.
New Undo Feature
Undo is now essentially unlimited on each screen.
Undo works with resets, death, and leaving the room.
Undo states stay in a room where changes are made as long as the player does not make changes in another room, moves more than 2 screens away, or enters another island.
Z has been added as a hotkey for undo.
The player can now skip the end screen cutscene.
New menu pointer design.
Some tilesets have been reworked to reduce visual noise.
Gems have been redesigned.
Other minor visual improvements.
The music no longer pauses during reset.

notes.title: Development of the Full Game has Begun!
notes.content:
Thank you so much everyone for your support and kinds words. We are so excited that we reached our funding goal and smashed through 2 stretch goals: A Nintendo Switch port, a new big island, and more music!

[b]What's Next?[/b]
[list]
[*] Demo Update: There's an update for the demo in the works that adds some much needed features like unlimited undo.
[*] Mac and Linux Demo: Likely to come some time next month.
[/list]
